config.text:
# Author: Nicola Antonello
# E3: dense retrieval with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B against the BM25 baseline (ADR-0009). The
# query prompt is the model's stored "query" prompt at this revision, verified on
# 2026-11-25; passages get none. It runs in float32, as E1 did, so the model is the one
# change. A config that produced a committed run is never edited (ADR-0023).
name = "dense-qwen3-embedding"

[[first_stage]]
kind = "dense"
model = "Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B"
revision = "97b0c614be4d77ee51c0cef4e5f07c00f9eb65b3"
weights_sha256 = "0437e45c94563b09e13cb7a64478fc406947a93cb34a7e05870fc8dcd48e23fd"
query_prompt = "Instruct: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query\nQuery:"
max_length = 8192
dtype = "float32"
